title: G Major Piano Chord (G): Notes, Inversions & PDF
description: Find G major on piano with G, B and D. Compare its inversions, try a note-building exercise and print the three-position keyboard reference.
user_task: Locate this exact triad and compare its three bass positions.
questions: Does a G major chord need F-sharp?
Is G major the same as G minor?
Why does the second-inversion example sound lower?
What does the keyboard exercise check?

blocks.heading: Notes and keyboard position
blocks.body: The G major chord contains G, B and D. Its formula is 1–3–5: a major third and a perfect fifth above G. The displayed root-position example is G4–B4–D5. Numbers after note letters identify octaves, not fingers. Use the diagram, note list and bass label together; Play chord sounds the selected notes together, while the note-by-note control sounds them from low to high.
blocks.evidence_status: [已核实] rules; [推断] register and original teaching example

blocks.heading: What to notice
blocks.body: The G major chord and the G major scale are different things. F-sharp belongs to the scale, but it is not one of the three chord tones. The triad shown here therefore uses only white keys. Adding F-sharp would change the three-note object being studied. Measured above G, B is four semitones away and D is seven. The interval formula describes the chord from its root, not the distances between every pair of currently adjacent keys. In G/B, G is still the root even though B is the lowest sounding note.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] original explanation from preserved note data and cited rules

blocks.heading: Compare three positions
blocks.body: Read each bass note before selecting a position. The root-position example starts with G; first inversion starts with B; second inversion starts with D. The chord tones stay the same. These are independently chosen reference registers, not an ascending exercise. Switching a position must update the selected note order, diagram, sound and current-print snapshot together. Hand numbers, when available, apply only to the root example.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] derived inversion explanation; controls are implementation acceptance requirements
